variants.name: 01-balanced-wave
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE refined mobile screenshot, portrait 390:844 proportions, no device frame, no collage, no annotations outside UI. Improve the provided navy Socially QR-sharing concept. Image 1 is the original concept to improve; image 2 is the actual Socially captain logo to use accurately at small size. Preserve pale ice-blue background, navy ink, soft white card, restrained frost, editorial Cormorant Garamond serif + Inter utility typography, 24-28px radii, delicate blue borders. This must feel like a deliberate refinement of the same design, not unrelated redesign.
Apply review corrections: compact top navigation with 'Share your QR' at 22px equivalent and circular 44px close X; at most one short subtitle. The bounded shareable card is entirely static: NO copy icons/buttons, NO share/save controls inside it. Use actual captain logo from image 2 next to SOCIALLY, not a sailboat substitute. Reduce navy banner to approximately 105-135 logical px, title 'Receive on Solana' at ~28px, single Solana network badge, no slogans. QR must be largest visual focus, approximately 220 logical px wide, dark navy modules on pure white with generous quiet zone and no overlay logo; illustrative QR only. Card footer contains label 'Wallet address' and COMPLETE illustrative address '7xK9mP4qN2vR8sT6uW3yZ5aB1cD9eF4gH6jL2nQ8rS5t' in readable monospaced two or three lines with no ellipsis. Small network note 'Solana network only'. Outside card, helper 'Only this card will be shared'. Primary dark navy pill 'Share image', at least 52px high, share glyph; secondary 'Save image' smaller and clearly secondary. Respect safe areas, keep all content and both actions on screen at 390x844. Strong practical spacing, no excessive ornamental chart lines, no competing large title, no invented metrics. Balanced wave refinement. Full light screen. Bounded white preview centered, compact navy horizontal brand row and editorial title header. Single extremely subtle compass watermark at right; one gentle pale blue wave transitions into white QR area. QR centered and dominant. Compact full-address footer. Share as wide primary button, Save as understated text with download glyph. This is the faithful best-balanced upgrade of original.
